question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main and the latest release still have one memory selector, but changing it adds durable public config/API surface, per-agent semantics, and migration obligations that automation should not decide.

options.title: Review The Linked Role-Slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof requirements there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow The Taxonomy First
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the PR to reduce, rename, or split role slots before public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject Core Role Slots
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide memory composition should remain outside core or use a different plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Role-Slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof requirements there before closing this issue.
